name: Quick Plot
description: Paste CSV, TSV, JSON or JSON Lines and get a line, bar or scatter chart in seconds, exported as PNG or SVG
help: Paste table text or open a file (or drop it on the window): the delimiter (comma, tab, semicolon, pipe or whitespace), header row and column types (number, time, text) are detected.
Objects in a JSON array are flattened into columns by dotted path (such as stats.p99); in API responses like {"data": [...]} the array is found automatically; JSON Lines has one object per line.
By default the first time column is the X axis and numeric columns are series. Switch between line, bar and scatter, move series to the right axis and turn on log scales.
Large data is downsampled (lines keep their shape with up to 2000 points; scatter keeps up to 5000). Hover to read values and export PNG or SVG. Data never leaves this computer.
